overview: The paper proposes Sandwiched Policy Gradient (SPG), a reinforcement learning algorithm for masked diffusion language models that optimizes sandwiched variational bounds (maximizing a lower bound for positive rewards and minimizing an upper bound for negative rewards) using a block-wise masking strategy for Monte Carlo estimation.

modules.name: Data Loading & Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles the loading, cleaning, and formatting of prompt-completion pairs for mathematical, logical, and coding datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, Countdown, Sudoku, HumanEval, MBPP), including train-test splitting and few-shot example management.

modules.name: Reward Function Suite
modules.description: Implements task-specific reward functions encompassing correctness evaluation, format and XML structure compliance, and safe code guarantees for the coding tasks.

modules.name: Masked Diffusion Core
modules.description: Implements the fundamental operations of Masked Diffusion Language Models, including the forward noising process (progressive token masking with a noise schedule) and the reverse denoising process parameterized by the policy network.

modules.name: Evidence Bounds Computation
modules.description: Calculates the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) for positive advantage traces and the Evidence Upper Bound (EUBO) based on Rényi variational bounds for negative advantage traces, including the mixture formulation that combines both for variance reduction.

modules.name: Monte Carlo Sampling & Masking
modules.description: Implements Monte Carlo estimation for the evidence bounds using different masking strategies, specifically comparing random masking against the proposed block-wise masking strategy that aligns with semi-autoregressive generation.

modules.name: Advantage Estimation
modules.description: Computes group-relative advantages from the rollout rewards, determining the sign of the advantage to dispatch the appropriate evidence bound (lower or upper) for each trace.

modules.name: Sandwiched Policy Gradient Objective
modules.description: Constructs the SPG loss function by maximizing ELBO for samples with positive advantages and minimizing EUBO (or the mixture) for samples with negative advantages, ensuring a valid lower bound on the true expected reward.

modules.name: Baseline RL Algorithms
modules.description: Implements baseline reinforcement learning algorithms for diffusion LLMs, including D1, WD1, UniGRPO, and a trajectory-level policy update method, adapting their specific log-likelihood estimations and optimization objectives.

modules.name: RL Training Loop
modules.description: Manages the overall reinforcement learning pipeline, including policy rollout generation, inner gradient updates, LoRA integration, gradient accumulation, and optimizer stepping.

modules.name: Decoding & Inference
modules.description: Implements various inference strategies for evaluating the trained models, including semi-autoregressive decoding with different block sizes, full sequence decoding, and confidence-based vs. random unmasking approaches.

modules.name: Evaluation & Metrics
modules.description: Computes evaluation metrics such as test accuracy across different generation lengths, Pass@K performance with higher temperatures, and tracks the effective sequence length of generated responses.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configures and executes ablation experiments to evaluate the contribution of individual components, such as the choice of likelihood estimation for negative traces, masking strategies, and the sensitivity to hyperparameters.

modules.name: Infrastructure & Utilities
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations via YAML/JSON, handles model checkpointing (saving and loading best states based on validation), and provides logging and monitoring integrations.
